process_name_raw: malting; brewing; wort boiling; pasteurisation
process_evidence_note: Official report documents malt drying; wort processing up to 97 C; bottle washing and pasteurisation with substantial heat demand.

process_name_raw: central refrigeration for fermentation and storage
process_evidence_note: Official report documents large cooling demand and a central refrigeration plant.

process_name_raw: mashing; wort boiling; thermal dealcoholisation; filling
process_evidence_note: Official EMAS environmental declaration documents mashing; wort boiling; thermal dealcoholisation; pasteurisation and cleaning-related heat uses.

process_name_raw: wort cooling; refrigerated maturation; absorption chilling
process_evidence_note: Official EMAS environmental declaration documents wort cooling; refrigerated storage tanks and an absorption chiller using CHP waste heat.

process_name_raw: injection moulding
process_evidence_note: Firm-specific evidence supports electric injection moulding and related automated production.

process_name_raw: injection moulding
process_evidence_note: Firm-specific evidence supports more than 100 injection-moulding machines in three-shift production.

process_name_raw: mechanical pretreatment; phosphating; powder coating; 100-200 C drying and curing
process_evidence_note: The official EMAS environmental statement documents powder-coating as the largest electricity and gas user; LPG process heat; compressed air, drives, pumps and motors; and drying stages at 100-200 C.

process_name_raw: zinc, zinc-iron and zinc-nickel electroplating; phosphating; heat treatment
process_evidence_note: Official company pages document electroplating and related finishing processes, 182 employees and three-shift production. No energy technology is inferred solely from the process mapping.

process_name_raw: spray drying; debinding; oxide- and silicate-ceramic sintering
process_evidence_note: Official production evidence documents debinding up to 1,100 C and sintering at 1,200-1,750 C in high-temperature and chamber furnaces.

process_name_raw: glass melting; colouring; mouth blowing; cylinder reheating and flattening
process_evidence_note: Official company evidence documents melting sand, soda and lime, colouring, mouth blowing and reheating cylinders in an oven before forming sheets.

process_name_raw: integrated cast-glass melting and rolling
process_evidence_note: Official company evidence documents in-house cast-glass production and all production stages; the ecology page separately documents optimisation of the melting furnace, firing method and cullet use.

process_name_raw: electroplating and surface treatment
process_evidence_note: Official company evidence documents galvanic surface-treatment operations and related digital process-data research. No energy technology is inferred solely from the process mapping.

process_name_raw: decorative anodising and hard anodising in serial production
process_evidence_note: Official company evidence documents Farbeloxal and Harteloxal processes. The batch and rectifier relevance belongs to the process mapping; deployed energy solutions remain UNKNOWN.

process_name_raw: glass painting, firing, etching and sandblasting
process_evidence_note: Company and network evidence document specialised batch glass treatment. PR007 is used provisionally for kiln-based batch firing; energy-system deployment remains UNKNOWN.

process_name_raw: brewing, bottle washing and filling
process_evidence_note: The NRW efficiency agency documents an energy-saving bottle washer integrated into the brewery filling line. Brewing is mapped as a batch heat process; no unreported utility system is inferred.

process_name_raw: brewing, wort heat, vapour compression and thermal buffering
process_evidence_note: Official evidence documents the new brewery heat system, heat pumps, vacuum vapour compression, waste-heat recovery and three thermal stores.

process_name_raw: electric injection moulding of plastic closures
process_evidence_note: Official evidence documents electric injection-moulding machines, closed-loop mould cooling and reuse of machine waste heat for space heating.

process_name_raw: injection moulding, toolmaking and product decoration
process_evidence_note: Official evidence documents single-site injection moulding and a direct ISO 50001 certificate valid through July 2029.

process_name_raw: injection moulding, injection compression and foam moulding
process_evidence_note: Official evidence documents injection-moulding production and onsite solar generation. No battery or load-management deployment is inferred.

process_name_raw: galvanic coating, zinc-flake coating and heat treatment
process_evidence_note: Official company evidence documents galvanic surface coating and heat treatment. No site energy solution is inferred from those processes.
